headline: Colombia's Nutresa Completes Acquisition of Venezuelan Unit Tio Rico
summary: Colombian food conglomerate Grupo Nutresa finalized its acquisition of Venezuelan ice cream producer Industrias Tio Rico, gaining control of eight brands, a manufacturing plant, and five regional distribution centers.
why: Nutresa is Colombia's leading packaged food manufacturer, and the transaction deepens its footprint across northern South American consumer markets.

impacts.name: Grupo Nutresa S.A.
impacts.why: Acquiring an established consumer brand and production assets expands regional distribution capacity.
